Join us in-person or virtually at our annual AnVIL Community Conference (ACC) to hear the latest and greatest of genomics analysis in the cloud, get hands-on experience with AnVIL, and meet the AnVIL community!



See the [event announcement](https://anvilproject.org/events/anvil2026-community-conference) for details and registration

[![](/assets/acc2026-handout.webp){width=80% fig-align="center"}](https://anvilproject.org/events/anvil2026-community-conference)

[Join the Mailing List](https://lists.anvilproject.org/lists/acc2026.lists.anvilproject.org){.btn .btn-primary}

**Deadlines**:

- Registration: **Aug 12**
- Abstract Submission
  - Oral presentations: **July 15**
  - Poster presentations: **Aug 10**
  
More details available in the [ACC 2026 event announcement](https://anvilproject.org/events/anvil2026-community-conference)
